gloss: somewhat thick; on the thick side; plumpish

definitions.gloss: somewhat thick; on the thick/heavy side; plumpish
definitions.explanation: Indicates something or someone is a little thicker or heavier than average. The め suffix softens the adjective, making it less direct than {太|ふと}い.

examples.japanese: {太|ふと}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write with a thicker pen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{太|ふと}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体型|たいけい}→体型：16561_taikei⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}ない→問題ない：26594_mondainai⟧。
examples.english: He's slightly on the heavy side, but there are no health issues.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix め to the adjective ⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧. The め suffix creates a softer, approximate expression. Can describe both objects (thick noodles, thick lines) and people's body types (plumpish), though when referring to people it serves as a more polite or indirect way of saying ⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {太|ふと}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{麺|めん}→麺：14644_men⟧: thicker noodles
- {太|ふと}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧: thicker thread
- {太|ふと}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体型|たいけい}→体型：16561_taikei⟧: a heavier build
- {太|ふと}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut into thicker pieces

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{細|ほそ}め→細め：20902_hosome⟧: on the thin side — the opposite
- ⟦{短|みじか}め→短め：20900_mijikame⟧: on the short side — same pattern
- ⟦{大|おお}きめ→大きめ：21239_ookime⟧: on the large side — same pattern
